values.note: 33 electric sites (F02-F34, gravel, mostly pull-through, max vehicle 24-74 ft) plus 3 walk-to tent sites and a pavilion.

season.source: https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/parks/flatiron-reservoir ('The reservoir is open year-round and requires entrance and camping permits.') + larimercamping.com campground page ('Status: Open year round.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Drinking water and vault restrooms in the campground; two frost-free spigots give potable water year-round. Nearest dump station ($15) and showers are at Carter Lake, about 5 miles, both closed in the off-season.

facilities.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/camping/flatiron-reservoir/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&siteId=520&parkId=710103 (notes: 'Drinking water and vault restrooms are located in each campground', 'Flatiron Campground has two frost-free water spigots with potable water hookups year-round', 'Dump stations: The dump station at Carter Lake ...', 'Showers: A shower house is available at Carter Lake - Eagle campground'; banner 'RV dump stations will cost $15 per session'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Same-day to 180 days ahead online or at 1-800-397-7795. Two-night minimum on weekends April-September; up to 14 days in any 30 across the county system. A daily vehicle entrance permit is required on top of the camping fee and can be bought with the reservation.

booking.source: https://www.larimer.gov/naturalresources/reservations/campgrounds ('Sites can be reserved from same-day up to 180 days in advance'; 'A two-night reservation is required for weekend dates April through September at all campsites'; 'Maximum stay is 14 days in any 30-day period in the entire system') + larimercamping.com site notes ('Same Day Reservations are allowed at Flatiron'; 'ENTRANCE PERMIT REQUIRED'), read 2026-10-27

note: Larimer County park on a 47-acre afterbay reservoir (~5,470 ft) northwest of Carter Lake; water levels rise and fall with power generation, so no swimming or boating; shore and pier fishing. --Claude
summary: Larimer County page + larimercamping.com (Aspira): electric 50 amp at every RV site (amperage was missing), 33 electric sites F02-F34 + 3 walk-to (count 34 -> 36), lengths to 74 ft (F03), mostly pull-through, open year round, same-day to 180 days, 2-night weekend minimum Apr-Sep, 14 in 30 max, vault toilets and year-round spigot water, dump/showers at Carter Lake. Fees left as stored (county permits page read 2026-10-16). Site coords sit 150-170 m from the pin. Imagery: the campground loops run along the reservoir's north shore with the east loop's pads tens of metres from the water, consistent with the stored lakefront; the reservoir is an afterbay whose level swings daily.
